title: Trust vs Confidence, in yourself, your skills & your environment
summary: Kahran has been thinking about how to build trust with clients, with teams and with users — a Peruvian company he mentors is losing time and breeding resentment because no one trusts anyone else's work. Divya pushes back, arguing trust is mostly the mental fortitude to trust yourself. They use a Korean idol training-show binge, Kahran starting Kathak in his thirties, and Divya's first day of MFA classes as test cases — and end up not persuading each other.
topics: building trust with users and teams
lack of trust kills team ownership

intents.display: to draw a line between trust and confidence in yourself and others
